definitions.explanation: The world in the sense of human society and life.
A period of time or reign; a generation.

examples.japanese: {世|よ}の{中|なか}にはいろいろな{人|ひと}がいる。
examples.english: There are all kinds of people in the world.

examples.japanese: {平成|へいせい}の{世|よ}が{終|お}わり、{令和|れいわ}になった。
examples.english: The Heisei era ended and Reiwa began.

examples.japanese: {親子|おやこ}{三|さん}{世|せい}で{暮|く}らしている。
examples.english: Three generations of the family live together.
examples.notes: [Note: {世|せい} is used when counting generations]

notes:
{世|よ} refers to the world in terms of society, life, or a period of time. It has a somewhat literary or philosophical nuance.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {世|よ}の{中|なか}: the world, society
- {世|よ}に{出|で}る: to go out into the world; to be published
- {世|よ}を{去|さ}る: to pass away (literary)
- {世|よ}も{末|すえ}: the world has gone to ruin

RELATED READINGS:
- {世界|せかい}: world (larger/global scope)
- {世紀|せいき}: century
- {世代|せだい}: generation
- ～{世|せい}: ~th generation (e.g., 3{世|せい} = third generation)
